source_description: Provisional compatibility profile derived from the Bike Test 2 recording and the manually reviewed v5 detection result. This is NOT a physically ground-truthed wheel-revolution calibration.

metrics.note: 673 is the v5 adaptive detection count from Bike Test 2. It is not an independently known spoke-strike count.

notes: TEST PROFILE ONLY. Created so session_analyzer.py can be exercised before a formal calibration recording exists. Replace this file with a genuine calibration_profile.json produced by src/calibrate.py before participant data collection.
